text: dsh-sessionflow 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话接续插件，通过在 tools 服务注册六个工具，把请求转交给本机 sessionFlow/Voyager core。用户可以搜索不同编码 Agent 的历史会话、查看近期活动和当前项目工作、读取整理后的会话上下文、继续未完成工作，并把多个会话合并为 WorkThread。它适合需要在 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 之间接续项目的人。使用前需单独安装并建立 sessionFlow 索引，且 DSH 要有可用模型 provider；插件本身不提供模型服务。

dsh-sessionflow adds six tools to DSH Web and forwards requests to a local sessionFlow/Voyager core. Search agent history, inspect recent work, preview context, continue a project, or merge sessions. Requires the separate core and a working DSH model provider.

Continue my previous work in this repository from its saved context.
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「跨 Agent 历史搜索」：可按查询词搜索已索引的编码 Agent 会话，并可限定 provider、仓库路径、时间范围和结果数量。
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「近期工作概览」：列出近期 WorkThread 和会话，可按仓库、provider、回看时长筛选，并返回统计信息。
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「会话上下文预览」：输入会话 ID 或前缀，获取包含目标、已验证状态、文件、命令和后续事项的紧凑上下文。
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「当前项目进度」：按当前工作区或指定仓库查询活跃工作线、成员会话和继续工作所需的上下文。
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「继续未完成工作」：按会话、WorkThread 或仓库范围生成续接上下文，并可提供目标和 token 预算。
dsh-sessionflow 的功能「合并多个历史会话」：选择一个或多个会话 ID，合并为 WorkThread 并返回综合上下文；此操作会持久化工作线。
dsh-sessionflow 需要另行安装并建立 sessionFlow/Voyager core 索引；core 不可用时工具仍注册，但调用会报告错误。
dsh-sessionflow 的合并工具会持久化 WorkThread；其余会话查询经本机 CLI 桥接，插件代码不自行读取或上传会话文件。

DSH as six tools.

```
User:  Continue the work I was doing in Claude Code on this repo.

DSH:   → sessionflow_current_work

**Say what you are looking for, not just "continue."** The tools fire far more
reliably on a lookup than on a bare action:

User:  What was I working on before? Continue from there.

dsh-sessionflow README · dsh-sessionflow：A bare *"Continue the unfinished work in this project"* is the weakest phrasing:
with nothing in the repository marking what is left, the agent may read the files
and start writing instead of consulting history. It will not invent history, but it
can miss work only the earlier sessions record — exactly the case this plugin is
for. See the [Quick Start](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md).

dsh-sessionflow README · What it is：A thin DSH plugin that exposes [sessionFlow](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow)
(Voyager) as six tools. sessionFlow indexes the session history of every AI
coding agent on your machine; this plugin lets a DSH agent *use* that history —
to find past work, to see what the current project was doing, and to pick it up.

dsh-sessionflow README · What it is：**The core stays the single source of truth.** No session parsing, indexing,
search, WorkThread, ranking, merging or context compilation happens in this
plugin: every call is forwarded to the existing Voyager core over its stable
JSON interface.

dsh-sessionflow README · Continuation, not native resume：These are two different things, and this plugin only does the first. Worth
knowing before you expect the second:

dsh-sessionflow README · Continuation, not native resume：| | What it is | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Native resume** | Hand an agent back its *own* earlier session, so it continues with full native state (`claude --resume`, `codex resume`). | **Not verified.** The plugin can report the command and the core records it, but no scenario here has launched another agent's session — that spends your credentials and writes into your real environment. |
| **Cross-agent continuation** | Compile *other* agents' work — goal, files, commands, open items, provenance — into a context package or bundle, and hand it to whatever agent you are in now. | **Verified.** See [verification status](#verification-status). |

dsh-sessionflow README · Continuation, not native resume：The second row is the point: it is what lets work cross an agent boundary at
all, including when the next agent has no way to resume the previous one.

dsh-sessionflow README · Requirements：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`)
  — verified on **0.1.5-rc.3** and **0.2.0-rc.2** (`next`), **with a working
  model provider**. A fresh `headless` profile has no LLM adapter and no
  credentials, and DSH stops with
  `MISSING_CREDENTIAL: … no credential for provider route "…"`. That is the
  host's configuration, not this plugin's: **this plugin does not provide model
  access** and cannot work around a missing provider. Set up the provider
  before installing anything here.
- [sessionFlow / Voyager](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow) — **a
  separate, standalone dependency**. This plugin is a thin DSH adapter and ships
  no Python core of its own. Without the core the six tools still register, and
  every call fails with a message naming the install command.
- Node.js **22.19+**

dsh-sessionflow README · Requirements：So there are two independent dependencies: DSH needs a model provider to run at
all, and this plugin needs the sessionFlow core to answer anything. The plugin
adds no third one.

The core is not on PyPI: the `voyager` name there belongs to an unrelated
nearest-neighbour library, so a bare `pip install voyager` installs the wrong
project. Always keep the `@ git+…` part of the command in the quick install
below.

dsh-sessionflow README · Core compatibility：The plugin is tested against a specific core release. Newer cores should work;
an older one is refused by name rather than misbehaving silently.

| plugin | core | bridge schema |
|---|---|---|
| **1.1.0** | `v1.3.0` | `1` |

dsh-sessionflow README · Core compatibility：**The two repos are versioned independently** — plugin `1.1.0` against core
`1.3.0` is the current, correct pairing, and the numbers are not meant to match.
What binds them is the **bridge schema**: `REQUIRED_SCHEMA_VERSION` in
`src/bridge.ts` is the value the plugin demands, and `voyager integration-info
--json` is where the core reports it.

dsh-sessionflow README · Core compatibility：What that compatibility rests on: the six tools are verified by **non-model
contract tests** (input → bridge call → result formatting) against a real core
on a seeded index. Model-driven *selection* of those tools has been observed in
recorded real-model runs, but there is **no repeatable end-to-end suite** for it —
see [verification status](#verification-status) and the prompt-shape note at the
top. Do not read "the tools work" as "the model will always reach for them".

dsh-sessionflow README · Core compatibility：> **Core v1.3.0 is released and is what the pin below installs.** It is tested
> against plugin v1.1.0: the six tools and the bridge schema (`1`) are
> unchanged, so no plugin upgrade is needed.  v1.3.0 adds evidence references
> inside bundle text and a new `voyager evidence` subcommand -- additive only;
> the plugin passes bundle text through and does not parse it, which is why it
> needs no change.

dsh-sessionflow README · Install：Two pieces, two different channels — there is no single command, and one of them
is deliberately not on a package registry:

| | Where it comes from | Install |
|---|---|---|
| **Core** — sessionFlow | a **GitHub tag**; not on PyPI | `pipx install "voyager[all] @ git+…@v1.3.0"` |
| **Plugin** — this repo | **DSH's plugin mechanism**; not on npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow` |

dsh-sessionflow README · Install：Install the core first: without it the six tools still register, but every call
fails with a message naming the missing binary.

Two things people get wrong here:

dsh-sessionflow README · Install：- **`pip install voyager` installs the wrong project.** That PyPI name belongs to
  an unrelated nearest-neighbour library. The core is not published to PyPI, so
  the `@ git+…` form below is the only correct one. `pipx` is the recommended
  runner because it keeps the CLI in its own environment — the tag install is
  what makes a reinstall reproducible.
- **The plugin is not an npm package.** `dsh plugin add dsh-sessionflow` finds
  nothing; use the `github:` specifier.

dsh-sessionflow README · Quick install：The core first, pinned to the release this plugin version was tested against:

```sh
pipx install "voyager[all] @ git+https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow.git@v1.3.0"
voyager --version     # must print 1.3.0
voyager scan          # build the index from your real agent history
voyager doctor        # confirm the core runs and reports bridge schema 1

dsh-sessionflow README · Quick install：No `pipx`? `python -m pip install "voyager[all] @ git+https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow.git@v1.3.0"`
works too. `python -m pip` is deliberate: on Windows `pip` is often not on `PATH`
while `python` is.

Then the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
dsh --profile web
```

The install is non-editable and pinned, so reinstalling reproduces the same
build — which a `git clone` plus `pip install -e .` does not.

dsh-sessionflow README · Working on the core itself：Developing against a checkout instead of an installed core:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow
cd sessionFlow && pip install -e .
voyager scan
```

That is a developer path. It is not what the quick install does, and it is not
what the plugin's error messages recommend.

dsh-sessionflow README · Working on the core itself：pnpm blocks build scripts for git-hosted packages until you allow them, so the
first `add` will stop and print the exact key it wants. Put that key in the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run the same `add` again:

```yaml

dsh-sessionflow README · <profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml — the key is printed by the failing `add`：allowBuilds:
  dsh-sessionflow@git+https://github.com/HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow.git#<sha>: true
```

The plugin needs that build step: it is TypeScript, and `prepare` compiles
`lib/` on install.
section: <profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml — the key is printed by the failing `add`

dsh-sessionflow README · From a local checkout：Working on the plugin itself? Use a `file:` specifier:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
cd dsh-sessionflow && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add file:$PWD
```

dsh-sessionflow README · From a local checkout：Use `file:`, not a bare path. A bare path becomes a pnpm `link:` dependency,
and DSH's `nodeLinker: hoisted` does not create the symlink for those — the
install looks like it worked, but the profile never sees `dsh.bundle` and the
plugin does not load. `file:` copies instead, which works.

dsh-sessionflow README · Verify：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep dsh-sessionflow
```

You should see `- id: dsh-sessionflow`. If the core is missing, the tools still
register but every call fails with a clear message naming the `voyager` binary —
see [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting).

dsh-sessionflow README · Tools：| Tool | What it answers |
|---|---|
| `sessionflow_search` | "Find the session where I fixed the parser." |
| `sessionflow_recent` | "What have I been doing this week?" |
| `sessionflow_session` | "Show me what that one session was about." |
| `sessionflow_current_work` | "Where did I leave off on *this* project?" |
| `sessionflow_continue` | "Pick the work back up." |
| `sessionflow_merge` | "Put these sessions together and let me continue." |

dsh-sessionflow README · Tools：All six share the `sessionflow_*` prefix — there is no second `voyager_*` set.
Every tool returns structured data and a model-readable rendering.

dsh-sessionflow README · When a repo has more than one WorkThread：A project can carry several active WorkThreads at once (two lines of work, or a
thread that was reopened after being closed). The tools will **not** choose
between them for you:
section: When a repo has more than one WorkThread

text:
dsh-sessionflow README · When a repo has more than one WorkThread：* `sessionflow_current_work` answers with `thread_ambiguous: true`, lists every
  candidate under `thread_candidates` (`id`, `title`, `updated_at`, `goal`), and
  still returns the most recently active one as `thread` — labelled by
  `thread_default_reason` as a default, because activity time is not a decision
  you made;
* `sessionflow_continue` and `sessionflow_merge` accept `thread_id`, so the
  agent can pass the one you pick;
* with exactly one thread nothing extra is added, and a `thread_id` that does
  not exist is reported rather than quietly replaced by another thread.
section: When a repo has more than one WorkThread

text:
dsh-sessionflow README · When a repo has more than one WorkThread：Ask the agent which thread you mean, or name the id yourself. The same rule
holds outside DSH: `voyager continue` / `voyager switch` refuse with the
candidate list instead of guessing, and `voyager status` reports `AMBIGUOUS`
rather than `NO_THREAD`.
section: When a repo has more than one WorkThread

dsh-sessionflow README · Configuration：The plugin finds the core by trying, in order: a configured `voyagerBin`, then
`voyager` on `PATH` (and `voyager.exe` on Windows), then `py` / `python` /
`python3` running `-m voyager.cli`. Each candidate is proven with a version
probe, so a machine with several Python installs picks the one that actually
has the package.

Override it in the profile patch:

```yaml

dsh-sessionflow README · cordis.patch.yml：- id: dsh-sessionflow
  config:
    voyagerBin: 'C:/path/to/voyager.exe'   # optional
    timeoutMs: 30000                        # optional, per call
```

If the core is missing, the tools fail with an actionable message rather than
an empty result.

dsh-sessionflow README · DSH host compatibility：Stated per channel, and at the level actually reached. The peer ranges admit the
`0.1.5` / `0.1.6` / `0.1.7` and `0.2.x` prerelease lines; how far each was taken
is a separate question:

dsh-sessionflow README · DSH host compatibility：| Plugin | DSH | bridge schema | install resolves | DSH loads it | tool call answered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1.0 | `0.1.5-rc.3` | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| 1.1.0 | `0.1.7-rc.2` | 1 | yes | not run | not run |
| 1.1.0 | `0.2.0-rc.2` (`next`) | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| 1.1.0 | `0.2.1-alpha.4` (`alpha`) | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| 1.2.0 | `0.2.1-rc.5` (`next`) | 1 | yes | yes | yes |
| 1.2.0 | `0.2.2-alpha.2` (`alpha`) | 1 | yes | yes | yes |

dsh-sessionflow README · DSH host compatibility："Not run" is not a euphemism for "probably fine" — `0.1.7-rc.2` is admitted so
that a user on it is not blocked by an install error, and nothing more is
claimed. The `latest` dist-tag is a stale `0.0.1-rc.1` upstream and is
deliberately **not** admitted: there is no evidence the plugin works on the
first release candidate, and claiming it so an install would succeed is the same
mistake in the other direction.

dsh-sessionflow README · DSH host compatibility：DSH is in Developer Preview and does move. The plugin declares the bridge
`schema_version` it needs and fails clearly against an older core; it does not
claim to support "all future versions". `tests/peer-range.test.ts` pins this
table, so widening a range forces a decision about the new row's status instead
of silently admitting it.

dsh-sessionflow README · Troubleshooting：**The tools are registered but every call fails.**
The core is missing or not on `PATH`. Check it directly:

```sh
voyager --version
```

If that fails, install the core (see [Install](#install)) and make
sure the interpreter that provides the `voyager` entry point is the one DSH
inherits. The error text names the binary it tried to run.

dsh-sessionflow README · Troubleshooting：**`pip install voyager` installed the wrong thing.**
It did — the `voyager` name on PyPI is an unrelated nearest-neighbour library.
Uninstall it and install from the sessionFlow repository instead.

**`dsh plugin add dsh-sessionflow` cannot find the package.**
The plugin is not on npm. Use the GitHub specifier instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
```

dsh-sessionflow README · Troubleshooting：**`add` fails with `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED`.**
pnpm will not run a git-hosted package's build script until you allow it. The
error prints the exact key — put it under `allowBuilds` in the profile's
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run the same `add` again. The plugin cannot skip this:
it ships TypeScript, and `prepare` is what compiles `lib/`.

dsh-sessionflow README · Troubleshooting：Use the key exactly as printed, including the resolved commit. With pnpm 11 the
short form (`dsh-sessionflow: true`) is *not* enough — it still fails with the
same error. Measured against pnpm 11.22.0.

**`add` reported `declares no dsh.bundle`, and `node_modules` is empty.**
You added a bare local path. pnpm turns that into a `link:` dependency, and with
DSH's `nodeLinker: hoisted` no symlink is created, so the profile cannot read the
package's `dsh.bundle`. Use `file:` instead:

dsh-sessionflow README · Troubleshooting：```sh dsh plugin --profile web add file:$PWD ``` The same warning with a `github:` or `file:` specifier means something else — check that `lib/` exists in the package, since DSH reads the manifest from the installed copy. **The plugin loads but a profile shows no `dsh-sessionflow` line.** Run `dsh --profile

--dump-config` and look for `- id: dsh-sessionflow`. If it is absent, the bundle was not discovered — see the two entries above.

dsh-sessionflow README · What stays local：Everything. This is the part worth being precise about, because the whole value
proposition is that your coding history does not leave your machine.

dsh-sessionflow README · What stays local：- **No account, no telemetry, no analytics.** The plugin makes no network calls
  of any kind — not even a version check. (`grep -rE 'fetch\(|https?://' src/`
  finds one string, in a help message.)
- **It does not read your session files.** It reads the index sessionFlow already
  built. Scanning provider directories — `~/.codex`, `~/.claude`, and the rest —
  is the core's job, and it is what `voyager scan` does; the plugin never opens
  those files, never copies them and never uploads them.
- **The only write is `voyager merge`**, which persists a WorkThread in your own
  local index. Every other call is read-only.
- **No shell string is ever built.** Arguments reach `spawn` as an argv array, so
  a query containing `;`, `"`, or CJK text is data, not syntax. There is no
  path by which a search query becomes a command.
- **The model sees what you would expect it to see.** Continuation context is
  assembled locally and then passed to your configured model provider — that
  provider is the only place any of it goes, and that is your provider choice,
  not this plugin's.

dsh-sessionflow README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsc -> lib/
npm test          # build, then node --test — 54 tests (bridge mechanics + live core)
```

dsh-sessionflow README · Development：`tests/bridge.test.ts` covers resolution, timeouts, malformed JSON, non-zero
exits and the compatibility gate against stub executables, then runs the real
JSON round-trip against the installed core on a seeded temporary index. Those
indexes are created under the OS temp directory and **removed when the suite
exits**; set `SESSIONFLOW_TEST_TMPDIR` to put them somewhere else.

dsh-sessionflow README · 这是什么：一个薄的 DSH 插件，把 [sessionFlow](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow)
（Voyager）暴露为六个 tool。sessionFlow 会索引你机器上所有编码 Agent 的会话历史；
本插件让 DSH Agent 能用上这段历史——找到过去的工作、看清当前项目做到哪了、并接着做。

**核心始终是唯一事实来源。** 会话解析、索引、搜索、WorkThread、排序、合并、上下文编译
全部不在这里发生：每次调用都通过核心稳定的 JSON 接口转发给已有的 Voyager core。

dsh-sessionflow README · 前置要求：- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）
  —— 实测版本 **0.1.5-rc.3**，且**模型 provider 必须可用**。全新的 `headless`
  profile 既没有 LLM adapter 也没有凭证，DSH 会直接停下并报
  `MISSING_CREDENTIAL: … no API key for provider route`。那属于**宿主的配置**，
  不是本插件的问题：**本插件不提供模型访问能力**，也无法绕过一个缺失的 provider。
  请先把 provider 配好，再装这里的东西。
- [sessionFlow / Voyager](https://github.com/HarryHeYu/sessionFlow) ——
  **一个独立的外部依赖**，从**它的 GitHub tag** 安装并建好索引。本插件是薄适配层，
  自带零 Python 核心。它**没有发布到 PyPI**：PyPI 上的 `voyager` 是一个毫不相干的
  最近邻搜索库，裸跑 `pip install voyager` 会装错项目。
- Node.js **22.19+**

dsh-sessionflow README · 前置要求：也就是说这里有**两个彼此独立**的依赖：DSH 需要模型 provider 才能运行，本插件需要
sessionFlow core 才能回答任何问题。本插件不会引入第三个。

dsh-sessionflow README · 安装：两部分走**不同的渠道**，没有一条命令能同时装好；而且其中一件是**故意**不上包管理器的：

| **插件** — 本仓库 | **DSH 的插件机制**；不在 npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow` |

先装核心：没有它，六个工具照样注册，但每次调用都会失败并指名缺的那个二进制。

dsh-sessionflow README · 从本地目录安装：要改插件本身？用 `file:` 前缀：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
cd dsh-sessionflow && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add file:$PWD
```

**用 `file:`，不要用裸路径。** 裸路径会变成 pnpm 的 `link:` 依赖，而 DSH 配的
`nodeLinker: hoisted` 不会为它创建 symlink —— 安装看起来成功了，但 profile
**读不到** `dsh.bundle`，插件不会加载。`file:` 走的是拷贝，能正常工作。

dsh-sessionflow README · 确认已加载：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep dsh-sessionflow
```

应当看到 `- id: dsh-sessionflow`。若 core 缺失，工具仍会注册，但每次调用都会
以明确的错误指出它尝试运行的 `voyager` 可执行文件 —— 见「疑难排查」。

dsh-sessionflow README · 工具：| Tool | 回答什么 |
|---|---|
| `sessionflow_search` | "找一下我修 parser 的那个会话。" |
| `sessionflow_recent` | "我这周都干了什么？" |
| `sessionflow_session` | "那个会话是关于什么的？" |
| `sessionflow_current_work` | "**这个**项目我做到哪了？" |
| `sessionflow_continue` | "接着做。" |
| `sessionflow_merge` | "把这些会话合起来，我接着做。" |

六个 tool 统一用 `sessionflow_*` 前缀，不存在第二套 `voyager_*` 名称。
每个 tool 返回结构化数据 + 适合模型消费的渲染。

dsh-sessionflow README · 同一仓库有多条 WorkThread 时：一个项目可以同时有多条 active WorkThread（两条工作线，或者一条被关闭后又重开的）。
这些 tool **不会**替你选：

* `sessionflow_current_work` 会返回 `thread_ambiguous: true`，在 `thread_candidates`
  里列出全部候选（`id` / `title` / `updated_at` / `goal`），同时仍把最近活动的那条放在
  `thread` 里 —— 并由 `thread_default_reason` 标明这是**默认**，因为活动时间不是你的决定；
* `sessionflow_continue` 与 `sessionflow_merge` 接受 `thread_id`，Agent 可以把你选的那条传进去；
* 只有一条线程时不会多出任何字段；`thread_id` 不存在时会被如实报告，而不是悄悄换成别的线程。

dsh-sessionflow README · 配置：插件按顺序寻找核心：配置的 `voyagerBin` → `PATH` 上的 `voyager`（Windows 上还有
`voyager.exe`）→ `py` / `python` / `python3` 执行 `-m voyager.cli`。每个候选都会用
版本探测验证，所以装了多个 Python 的机器会选到真正装了包的那个。

在 profile patch 里覆盖：

```yaml

dsh-sessionflow README · cordis.patch.yml：- id: dsh-sessionflow
  config:
    voyagerBin: 'C:/path/to/voyager.exe'   # 可选
    timeoutMs: 30000                        # 可选，单次调用超时
```

核心缺失时，tool 会给出可执行的错误信息，而不是返回空结果。

dsh-sessionflow README · 兼容性：**两个仓库各自独立发版**——插件 `1.1.0` 配核心 `1.3.0` 是当前正确的组合，
版本号不需要相同。真正约束它们的是 **bridge schema**：插件在 `src/bridge.ts`
里声明 `REQUIRED_SCHEMA_VERSION`，核心在 `voyager integration-info --json` 里报告它。

| 插件 | 核心 | bridge schema |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1.0 | `v1.3.0` | 1 |

六个 tool 的兼容性由**非模型**的契约测试保证（输入 → bridge 调用 → 结果格式化，
对着真实核心和临时索引）。模型**自主选择**这些 tool 在真实模型回合里被观察到过，
但**没有**可重复的端到端套件——见[验证状态](#验证状态)。

DSH 处于 Developer Preview，接口会变。按渠道如实标注达到的等级：

dsh-sessionflow README · 兼容性：| 插件 | DSH | bridge schema | 能装上 | DSH 能加载 | 能回答 tool 调用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1.0 | `0.1.5-rc.3` | 1 | 是 | 是 | 是 |
| 1.1.0 | `0.1.7-rc.2` | 1 | 是 | 未跑 | 未跑 |
| 1.1.0 | `0.2.0-rc.2`（`next`） | 1 | 是 | 是 | 是 |
| 1.1.0 | `0.2.1-alpha.4`（`alpha`） | 1 | 是 | 是 | 是 |

"未跑"不等于"大概没问题"——`0.1.7-rc.2` 被放行只是为了不让用户卡在安装报错上，
此外不作任何声明。`latest` 是上游陈旧的 `0.0.1-rc.1`，**故意不收录**：
没有证据表明插件在第一个 release candidate 上能用。

dsh-sessionflow README · 疑难排查：**工具注册了，但每次调用都失败。**
core 缺失或不在 `PATH` 上。直接检查：

```sh
voyager --version
```

若失败，按[安装](#安装)从源码装 core，并确认提供 `voyager` 入口的解释器就是 DSH
继承到的那个。错误信息里会写出它尝试运行的可执行文件。

**`pip install voyager` 装错了东西。**
确实会 —— PyPI 上的 `voyager` 是一个毫不相干的最近邻搜索库。先卸载，再从
sessionFlow 仓库装。

**`dsh plugin add dsh-sessionflow` 找不到包。**
插件不在 npm 上。改用 GitHub 写法：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
```

dsh-sessionflow README · 疑难排查：**`add` 报 `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED`。**
pnpm 默认不允许 git 来源的包执行构建脚本。错误里会打印它需要的那个 key ——
写进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds`，再跑一次同样的 `add`。
这一步**不能跳过**：插件是 TypeScript，`prepare` 负责编译 `lib/`。

key 必须**原样照抄**，包括解析出的 commit。pnpm 11 下短名形式
（`dsh-sessionflow: true`）**不够**，仍会报同一个错 —— 已对 pnpm 11.22.0 实测。

dsh-sessionflow README · 疑难排查：**`add` 报 `declares no dsh.bundle`，且 `node_modules` 是空的。** 你加的是**裸本地路径**。pnpm 会把它变成 `link:` 依赖，而 DSH 配的 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 不创建 symlink，于是 profile 读不到包里的 `dsh.bundle`。 改用 `file:`： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add file:$PWD ``` 若用的是 `github:` 或 `file:` 却仍看到这条警告，那就是别的原因 —— 检查包里 是否存在 `lib/`，因为 DSH 读的是**已安装副本**的 manifest。 **插件加载了，但 profile 里看不到 `dsh-sessionflow` 那一行。** 跑 `dsh --profile

--dump-config`，找 `- id: dsh-sessionflow`。 找不到的话 bundle 没被发现 —— 见上面两条。

dsh-sessionflow README · 安全：- 参数以 **argv 数组**传给 `spawn`，绝不拼接 shell 字符串——含 `;`、`"` 或中文的查询
  是数据，不是语法。
- 插件**没有任意 shell 执行能力**。它只能调用核心的只读接口，外加 `voyager merge`
  （唯一的写操作，用于持久化 WorkThread）。
- 只读取 sessionFlow 已经建好的索引；不扫描、不复制、不上传 provider 会话文件，
  也不发送任何网络请求。

dsh-sessionflow README · 开发：```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsc -> lib/
npm test          # 先构建，再跑 node --test（bridge 机制 + 真实核心）
```

`tests/bridge.test.ts` 用 stub 可执行文件覆盖解析、超时、坏 JSON、非零退出和兼容性闸门，
再用**真实核心**在临时索引上跑一遍完整的 JSON 往返。这些临时索引建在系统临时目录下，
**测试退出时会被删除**；用 `SESSIONFLOW_TEST_TMPDIR` 可以改到别处。
